title: 最长有效括号
statement: 给定只由 '(' 和 ')' 组成的字符串 s，求其中最长的、括号正确匹配的连续子串的长度。

complexity.space: O(n) 额外空间（栈或 DP 数组）；左右两遍计数法可做到 O(1)
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为字符串长度。栈中保存“最后一个未匹配右括号”的下标作为基准；或从左到右、从右到左各扫一遍，统计左右括号数相等时的长度。空串答案为 0。

en.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
en.statement: Given a string s consisting only of '(' and ')', find the length of its longest contiguous substring in which the parentheses are correctly matched.

complexity.space: O(n) extra space (stack or DP array); the two-pass left/right counting method achieves O(1)
complexity.notes: n is the string length. Keep the index of the "last unmatched closing parenthesis" on the stack as the base; or scan once left to right and once right to left, recording the length whenever the counts of '(' and ')' are equal. The answer for an empty string is 0.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: one line, the string s (may be an empty line). stdout: one integer, the length of the longest valid parentheses substring.

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：一行字符串 s（可能为空行）。stdout：一个整数，最长有效括号子串的长度。
